summary: Wallbox N.V. published materials for its scheduled Annual General Meeting to be held on May 22, 2026, covering routine shareholder items: adoption of annual accounts, director reappointments, auditor reappointment, and share buyback authorization. Agenda item 10 references a combined proposal to approve pledges and warrants in connection with a restructuring, but the filing does not disclose specific terms, make a material change in corporate control, or trigger a special situation. The 6-K merely disseminates ordinary meeting materials, not a transformative event.
